description: Maximum LIHTC gross rent and tenant-paid rent for one unit: county, bedroom count and AMI level, less an optional utility allowance, from HUD FY2026 MTSP limits by the IRS Publication 5913 method, with the formula.

county.description: County name, e.g. "Harris County" or "Harris"; in New England, a town ("Boston"). Use fips when a name is ambiguous.

fips.description: 5-digit county FIPS (48201) or HUD's 10-digit area code (county + county subdivision, e.g. 2502507000 for Boston)

state.description: Two-letter state or territory code (CA, DC, PR) or name

utility_allowance.description: Monthly utility allowance for tenant-paid utilities, dollars (default 0)

name: calculate_max_rent
title: Maximum LIHTC rent
